description: How the Accountant Agent sends messages and files on this company's behalf. Each channel is off until it is both configured and ticked, so installing the app never gives the agent the ability to contact anyone.

fields.options: Email is sent straight from your own mailbox over SMTP, so any address works - a free Gmail account, Google Workspace, Outlook, or your own mail server. For Gmail, leave the server settings as they are and put a 16-character App Password in the password box: Google refuses a normal account password, and an App Password is created at myaccount.google.com/apppasswords once 2-Step Verification is on.

fields.label: Send email from this mailbox
fields.description: Off until an administrator has completed the setup. The agent refuses to send email while this is unticked, whatever it is asked.

fields.label: Send As
fields.description: The mailbox the message comes from - for example accounts@yourcompany.com. For Gmail this is the same address you sign in with. Most providers refuse to send from an address the account does not own.

fields.label: Sender Display Name
fields.description: The name recipients see, for example 'Acme Accounts'. Optional.

fields.label: Mail Server
fields.description: The outgoing mail server. Gmail: smtp.gmail.com. Outlook: smtp-mail.outlook.com. Your own server: ask whoever runs it.

fields.label: Port
fields.description: 587 for STARTTLS (the usual choice), 465 for SSL. Leave it and the right one is used for the security setting below.

fields.label: Security
fields.description: How the connection is encrypted. STARTTLS suits almost every provider, Gmail included. 'None' sends in the clear and is only for a mail server inside your own network.

fields.label: Username
fields.description: The account that signs in to the mail server. Leave empty to use the Send As address, which is right for Gmail and most providers.

fields.label: Password / App Password
fields.description: Stored encrypted and never sent to the agent server - this site makes the connection itself. GMAIL WILL NOT ACCEPT YOUR NORMAL PASSWORD: turn on 2-Step Verification, then create a 16-character App Password at myaccount.google.com/apppasswords and paste it here.

fields.label: Last Problem
fields.description: What the mail server said the last time a send failed. Cleared on the next success.

fields.label: Saved Recipients
fields.description: Email reaches any address, so this is an address book and not a fence. Save the people you send to often and the agent knows them by name: 'email the trial balance to Marwan' needs no address typed. Giving a full address instead still works, and always will.

fields.options: A Telegram bot cannot start a conversation. It can only send to a chat that already exists - a group or channel you have added the bot to, or a person who has pressed Start on it. There is no way to send to a phone number. Add each chat below. To find a chat's id, add the bot to the chat, send it any message, then open https://api.telegram.org/bot<your-token>/getUpdates in a browser and read chat.id.

fields.label: Send messages through Telegram
fields.description: Off until a bot token and at least one destination are saved.

fields.label: Bot Token
fields.description: The token BotFather gave you, in the form 123456789:AA... Stored encrypted. Anyone holding it can post as your bot, so treat it as a password.

fields.label: Last Problem
fields.description: What Telegram said the last time a send failed. Cleared on the next success.

fields.label: Destinations
fields.description: The agent can only send to a chat listed here. It cannot invent a destination, and it cannot message someone who has not started the bot.

fields.options: A Slack bot can only post where it has been invited. Create a Slack app with a bot token (scopes chat:write and files:write), install it to your workspace, then /invite the bot into each channel you list below. There is no way to send to a person or channel the bot has not been added to. A scope added after installing does not take effect until the app is reinstalled to the workspace.

fields.label: Send messages through Slack
fields.description: Off until a bot token and at least one destination are saved.

fields.label: Bot Token
fields.description: The Bot User OAuth Token from your Slack app's 'OAuth & Permissions' page, in the form xoxb-... Stored encrypted. Anyone holding it can post as your bot, so treat it as a password.

fields.label: Last Problem
fields.description: What Slack said the last time a send failed. Cleared on the next success.

fields.label: Destinations
fields.description: The agent can only post to a channel listed here. It cannot invent a destination, and it cannot post to a channel the bot has not been invited to.

name: Agent Messaging Settings
